code: path <- system.file("extdata", "example.Q-View", package = "qviewparsR") qv <- read_qview(path, verbose = FALSE)  out <- tempfile() dir.create(out) qv |>   write_qview_rds(file.path(out, "plate.rds")) |>   write_qview_csv(file.path(out, "plate_csv")) list.files(out, recursive = TRUE) #>  [1] "plate.rds"                       "plate_csv/analytes.csv"          #>  [3] "plate_csv/concentrations.csv"    "plate_csv/curve_fit.csv"         #>  [5] "plate_csv/manifest.csv"          "plate_csv/metadata.csv"          #>  [7] "plate_csv/pixel_intensities.csv" "plate_csv/plate_layout.csv"      #>  [9] "plate_csv/segments.csv"          "plate_csv/well_groups.csv"
